Evidence:
[1] While touring the US and UK with Rogue Wave, Jason Collett, Cold War Kids, Giant Drag and We Are Scientists, they recorded their first full-length album, "On the Wing Now", in the fall/winter of 2005, self-released 500 or so copies that they sold on the previously mentioned tours, and officially released the album with Dim Mak on August 21, 2007.
[2] The line-up of The Clouds has changed several times with different drummers and lead guitarists.
[3] The band was founded in 2003 by Annie Hardy who continues to be the band's sole singer and songwriter.
